heading: Chief of examining division
lead: The Comptroller of the Currency may designate a national bank examiner to act as chief of the examining division in his office.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section is based on Treasury Department Appropriation Act, 1924, act Jan. 3, 1923.

notes.heading: Similar Provisions
notes.text: Similar provisions were contained in act Feb. 17, 1922, ch. 55, 42 Stat. 375, and in earlier appropriation acts.

notes.heading: Exception as to Transfer of Functions
notes.text: Functions vested by any provision of law in Comptroller of the Currency, referred to in this section, not included in transfer of functions to Secretary of the Treasury, see note set out under section 1 of this title.
